sentences.text: The extinct sauropod dinosaur Vahiny means "traveller" in Malagasy and is known from the Late Cretaceous Maevarano Formation in northwestern Madagascar.
Vahiny is most similar to the Late Cretaceous Indian dinosaur Jainosaurus and shares similarities with the South American taxa Muyelensaurus and Pitekunsaurus.
Kristina Curry Rogers and Jeffrey A. Wilson first described and named the genus Vahiny and its type species Vahiny depereti in 2014.
Vahiny is classified within the unranked family Titanosauria.
The parent group for the genus Vahiny is Lithostrotia.
Vahiny lived in a semiarid coastal floodplain environment that experienced distinct wet and dry seasons.
Vahiny lived during the Late Cretaceous, between 70 and 66 million years ago in the Maastrichtian stage.
The time range for Vahiny is the Maastrichtian, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
